# plan 2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1
# local results -> /runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1
# [sync] mkdir node0
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
mkdir -p "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench" "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1"
LAB_EOF
# [sync] copy bench scripts to node0
scp -q /src/tools/lab/remote/bench_latency.py /src/tools/lab/remote/probe_env.py node0:inference-sim-lab/bench/
# [clean] stop stale processes on node0
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[b]ench_latency.py' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm bench serve' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm serve' || true; pkill -f '[V]LLM::' || true; docker rm -f lab-2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin/ray" stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
LAB_EOF
# [preflight] probe node0 -> probe-node0.json
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
docker run --rm --runtime=nvidia -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HF_HOME="/hf" -e HOME="/tmp" -e VLLM_CACHE_ROOT="/tmp/vllm-cache" -e PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" -e CUDA_HOME="/usr/local/cuda" -v "$HOME/.cache/huggingface:/hf" -v "$HOME/inference-sim-lab:/lab" --entrypoint python3 vllm/vllm-openai:v0.29.0 /lab/bench/probe_env.py
LAB_EOF
# [launch] start static-batch benchmark
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
docker run -d --name lab-2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1 --runtime=nvidia -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HF_HOME="/hf" -e HOME="/tmp" -e VLLM_CACHE_ROOT="/tmp/vllm-cache" -e PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" -e CUDA_HOME="/usr/local/cuda" -v "$HOME/.cache/huggingface:/hf" -v "$HOME/inference-sim-lab:/lab" --entrypoint python3 vllm/vllm-openai:v0.29.0 /lab/bench/bench_latency.py --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct --shapes 1x512,1x2048,8x512,8x2048,32x512 --decode 128 --warmup 2 --iters 5 --tp 1 --pp 1 --dtype bfloat16 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --max-model-len 4096 --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --max-num-seqs 64 --seed 0 --output /lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1/results.jsonl
LAB_EOF
# [wait] static-batch results (poll until complete=1, expected=5, timeout=3600s)
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
n=$(grep -c '^{.*"record": "lab.static_batch.v1"' "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1/results.jsonl" 2>/dev/null); d=$(grep -c '^{.*"record": "lab.done.v1"' "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1/results.jsonl" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$(docker ps -q --filter name=^lab-2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1$)" ]; then a=1; else a=0; fi; if [ "${d:-0}" -ge 1 ] && [ "${n:-0}" -ge 5 ]; then c=1; else c=0; fi; echo "complete=$c progress=${n:-0} alive=$a"
LAB_EOF
# [collect] dump container log
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
docker logs lab-2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1 > "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1/bench.log" 2>&1
LAB_EOF
# [collect] collect results.jsonl
scp -q node0:inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1/results.jsonl /runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1/measured.jsonl
# [collect] collect bench.log
scp -q node0:inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1/bench.log /runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1/bench.log
# [teardown] stop stale processes on node0
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[b]ench_latency.py' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm bench serve' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm serve' || true; pkill -f '[V]LLM::' || true; docker rm -f lab-2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin/ray" stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
LAB_EOF
